  2. Never compliment a person of the opposite sex about something they cannot change, unless you are trying to show interest in starting a relationship with that person. "I love the color of your eyes!" vs. "The way your jewelry matches your outfit is amazing!"

Some people take a little work to get up to that level of trust, others appreciate the brave and bold, but ultimately it is up to you to decipher that person's expectations before going for it. There is always a risk of being denied, but if there's a 1% chance, there's still a chance!
